shared_elements: low-relief carving of creatures on a flat vertical stone surface
outlined animal bodies with simple limbs
justification: Both surfaces depict animals rendered in profile as raised-outline relief on a flat panel, which is the only real correspondence, and it is a generic one. A shows a single isolated quadruped striding across an otherwise empty field, whereas B is a crowded all-over composition of many interlocking creatures, birds and a large fan/branch-like motif, so the density, subject range and compositional logic differ fundamentally.
